Features

Caravel

The Caravel Package Manager is specifically built for Tridentu Linux. It features easy downloading and installation of packages (dotfiles included), Lua scripting (for hooks and installation scripts) and a simple manifest.

Package Manager Universal

AppImage Support

Tridentu Linux comes with AppImage support out of the box like most distros. But there's more. It features not only support, but extensively features it too (a dedicated folder and launcher widget to be precise).

Built-in Feature GT+

Elegant Desktop

For elegance and usability, Tridentu 2K comes with an elegant and simple look and feel (similar to MacOS). If you want to change it, there are multiple themes for that across multiple distro variants.

Built-in Feature GT+

Flatpak

Tridentu-2K has Flatpak support out of the box. This also means that you have better control over what apps reside on your system - something that the CMR (Caravel Main Repository) and Ishimura (APT repository) could barely give you.

Package Manager GT+

Documentation

Tridentu 2K takes advantage of KDE's builtin Docbook functionality to give you the documentation that you need and deserve. There is also a wiki available for Tridentu 2 as well (since 1.5).

Built-in feature K Only

TUI Installer

Tridentu 2 comes with a TUI-based installer program that can be a great alternative on desktop flavors to the Calamares installer. This one is based on Void Linux's installer.

OS Installer Universal

Accessibility Support

Tridentu 2 now has better accessibility support than ever. Need to run a braille reader/writer on CT? We support that. Need to hear the text? We support that. We also support different input methods on the K variant as well. The K and GT variants also come with Orca for graphical screen reading.

Built-in feature Universal

Dual Launchers

Don't like Krunner? Have no fear! On Tridentu 2, all you have to do is just press Alt + Space to access Vicinae.

Built-in feature GT+
